coder_notes: Trial likely fails S5: conditions are 'Glioma' only and glioblastoma is not named anywhere; coded not_glioblastoma (alternative: high_grade_glioma_unspecified). Temozolomide is given at a low-dose 7-day schedule (50 mg/m2 days 1-7) as part of the investigational combination, so coded established_therapy_experiment. Pembrolizumab and olaparib are the investigational agents. HRR-mutation enrichment (cohort B) matches olaparib (PARP inhibitor).
